intro.title: Licensing for this device
intro.body: Poseidon is unlocked by a signed license key. This screen does not generate keys — it activates a key issued to you and shows the current state, plan, included features and validity. Once activated, the plan's features become available.
intro.howToTest: To test activation, paste a key in the XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX format and click "Activate license". Malformed keys are rejected immediately; the key must also have been issued and signed by the vendor to be accepted.

licenses.postExpiryNotice: Even after the license expires, reading and exporting your data remain available.

state.title: License state
state.none: No license activated on this device. Activate below to unlock the features.

activation.title: Activation
activation.invalidFormat: The key must use the XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX format.
activation.error: Could not activate the license. Please try again.
